definitions.explanation: The ability to grasp the meaning, nature, or significance of something.
A sympathetic awareness of another's situation or feelings.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}の{理解|りかい}が{深|ふか}まった。
examples.english: My understanding of this problem deepened.

examples.japanese: ご{理解|りかい}とご{協力|きょうりょく}をお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: We ask for your understanding and cooperation.
examples.notes: Polite request commonly used in announcements

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{理解|りかい}のある{人|ひと}だ。

notes:
USAGE: {理解|りかい} can refer to intellectual understanding or to sympathetic appreciation of someone's situation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{理解|りかい}する (to understand)
・{理解|りかい}を{深|ふか}める (to deepen understanding)
・{理解|りかい}を{得|え}る (to gain understanding/approval)
・{理解|りかい}のある (understanding, sympathetic)
・ご{理解|りかい}ください (please understand - polite)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{分|わ}かる - to understand (casual verb)
・{把握|はあく} - grasp, understanding (formal)
・{納得|なっとく} - acceptance, being convinced
